svg.title: Vulnerability management pipeline — OpenVAS to DefectDojo
svg.desc: Flowchart showing four pipeline stages: environment setup, OpenVAS scanning, export, and DefectDojo import and prioritisation, with sub-steps and three prioritised vulnerability findings at the bottom.
svg.text: OpenVAS → export → DefectDojo · Metasploitable2 · Arsalan Rasool Rather · CyArt
